nodes.instruction: Among the students from the Student_Club who attended the event "Women's Soccer", how many of them want a T-shirt that's in medium size? (Read it as the book does: over the students who attended the event named 'Women's Soccer', count the DISTINCT members whose T-shirt size is 'Medium'.) Record the answer in answers as kind='eligible_lots'.

nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-debit_card_specializing 1473): the benchmark rate index — a second, cross-book numeric input woven into the distribution arithmetic.
nodes.instruction:
What was the average monthly consumption of customers in SME for the
               year 2013? Read it as the book does: average the Consumption figure over
               the 2013 monthly records of SME customers, then divide THAT AVERAGE BY 12
               — the stored Consumption is a yearly-scale figure, so the monthly answer
               is one twelfth of the average, not the average itself. (Read it as the book does: over SME-segment customers, take the average of the 2013 monthly consumption rows divided by 12; report it EXACTLY as the book computes it — keep the book's own decimal value.) Record the answer in answers as kind='rate_index'. (This benchmark rate index feeds the distribution uplift.)

nodes.verdict_basis: dedicated CRM status write; the value is bound to the re-derived tier
nodes.rule: tier = 'TIER_3_SPECIAL_REVIEW' if round(the live rate index)*1000 >= 100000000; 'TIER_2_REGISTRAR_ESCALATION' if >= 100000; else 'TIER_1_STANDARD_PAYOUT'; re-derived live (type-C, never in answers)
nodes.follows: threshold banding on a live source aggregate (the debit_card_specializing rate index), not a relabel of a stored value
inputs: rate index <- live bird_debit_card_specializing (re-derived at write time)

nodes.context: Set up the institutional holder's service engagement in the desk's CSM register — only once the distribution tier is stamped on the CRM (the tier gates the engagement).

artifacts.A_out: eops CSM Wayne Enterprises support contract + entitlement + SSL case + SLA

nodes.instruction: Set up the institutional holder's service engagement in the desk's CSM register. For the 'Wayne Enterprises' account: set an active 'support' contract (contract_price 150000, start_date '2026-01-01', end_date '2026-12-31'); add a 'premium' 'h24x7' entitlement on 'Windows Server 2022 Datacenter' (max_cases_per_month 50, active) under that contract; open the 'SSL termination issue on Windows Server node' case on the 'phone' channel at 'high' priority in state 'in_progress' for a primary, active contact of that account; and put its 'SLA Response - High' response SLA in stage 'in_progress'. Only after the registrar-lead CRM status carries the '[DDX-TIER]' tier stamp whose tier matches the live re-derivation.

verifier.name: csm_support_contract_active
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eops_sn_csm_server_contract c JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Wayne Enterprises' AND c.contract_type = 'support' AND c.status = 'active' AND c.start_date = '2026-01-01' AND c.end_date = '2026-12-31' AND c.contract_price = 150000

verifier.name: csm_premium_entitlement_on_product
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eops_sn_csm_server_entitlement e JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_account a ON a.account_id = e.account_id JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_product p ON e.product_id = p.product_id WHERE a.name = 'Wayne Enterprises' AND e.support_level = 'premium' AND e.coverage_hours = 'h24x7' AND e.max_cases_per_month = 50 AND e.active = 1 AND p.name = 'Windows Server 2022 Datacenter'

verifier.name: csm_ssl_case_high_in_progress
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eops_sn_csm_server_customer_case cc JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_account a ON cc.account_id = a.account_id JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_contact c ON cc.contact_id = c.contact_id JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_product p ON cc.product_id = p.product_id WHERE a.name = 'Wayne Enterprises' AND p.name = 'Windows Server 2022 Datacenter' AND cc.short_description = 'SSL termination issue on Windows Server node' AND cc.channel = 'phone' AND cc.priority = 'high' AND cc.state = 'in_progress' AND c.is_primary = 1 AND c.active = 1 AND cc.sys_updated_on > cc.sys_created_on

verifier.name: csm_response_sla_in_progress
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eops_sn_csm_server_case_sla cs JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_customer_case cc ON cc.case_id = cs.case_id JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_sla_definition s ON s.sla_def_id = cs.sla_def_id WHERE cc.short_description = 'SSL termination issue on Windows Server node' AND s.name = 'SLA Response - High' AND s.metric = 'response' AND cs.stage = 'in_progress'

verifier.name: csm_entitlement_under_support_contract
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eops_sn_csm_server_entitlement e JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_contract c ON e.contract_id = c.contract_id JOIN eops_sn_csm_server_account a ON c.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Wayne Enterprises' AND c.contract_type = 'support' AND c.start_date = '2026-01-01' AND e.support_level = 'premium' AND e.coverage_hours = 'h24x7'

nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-california_schools 34): the independent side ratio for the quarterly overview.
nodes.instruction: Take the quarter's first side-anchor reading, at the close of the run, once the distribution's own figures are settled and the close-out is ready to sign. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — unrelated to the register and rate-index books this quarter's figures come off, on purpose — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: "What is the free rate for students between the ages of 5 and 17 at the school run by Kacey Gibson?" (Read it as the book does: the free meal count for ages 5-17 as a real number divided by the enrollment for ages 5-17, at the school administered by Kacey Gibson.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_ratio'. (A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off, and the close-out is signed only when this quarter's two anchor readings line up with the last. Report the book's own figure exactly — a ratio below 1, kept to the book's own decimals; one rounded to look tidy would read as a holder-register move that never happened.)
